name: bellman
description: Bellman rooms in Claude Code. The bridge runs as an MCP server: it signs you in, proxies the bellman_* tools and queues peer events for the session. A monitor prints each message or action request as it lands, and the Stop hook hands the rest to Claude when a turn ends, and with BELLMAN_MEMORY_CAPTURE on asks once a session whether anything durable belongs in home memory. Three skills: room-manifest, to author a room's .bellman/room.yaml, choose between the pair, swarm, review and social presets, declare a hosted seat, and decide which verbs each role should hold; canvas, to write, arrange and read a room's working surface, the plan, decisions, diagrams, links and files every member reads; and memory-import, to turn a pasted Claude or ChatGPT memory export, or a CLAUDE.md, into home notes.

monitors.name: bellman-events
monitors.description: Peer events from your Bellman rooms, as they arrive
